double \coloneqq (n : \mathbb{N}) \mapsto n + n
\forall n : \mathbb{N},\ n \cdot 1 = n
\forall n : \mathbb{N},\ n + 1 = n
\forall n : \mathbb{N},\ n + 0 = n
\forall n : \mathbb{N},\ n > 2 \land 2 \mid n \implies \exists p : \mathbb{N},\ \exists q : \mathbb{N},\ \operatorname{Prime}(p) \land \operatorname{Prime}(q) \land p + q = n
\exists p : \mathbb{N},\ \exists q : \mathbb{N},\ \operatorname{Prime}(p) \land \operatorname{Prime}(q) \land p + q = 100
\forall n : \mathbb{N},\ \operatorname{double}(n) = 2 \cdot n
\forall a, b : \mathbb{N},\ \gcd(a, b) \mid a
\forall a, b : \mathbb{N},\ \min(a, b) \le \max(a, b)
\forall x : \mathbb{R},\ \left|x\right| \ge 0
\forall x : \mathbb{R},\ x \ge 0 \implies \sqrt{x} \cdot \sqrt{x} = x
\forall n : \mathbb{N},\ (n + 1)! = (n + 1) \cdot n!
\forall n : \mathbb{N},\ \binom{n}{1} = n
\forall n : \mathbb{N},\ \sum_{i = 0}^{n - 1} (2 \cdot i + 1) = n^{2}
\forall n : \mathbb{N},\ \prod_{i = 0}^{n - 1} (i + 1) = n!
\forall x : \mathbb{R},\ \log(\exp(x)) = x
\forall x : \mathbb{R},\ \sin(x)^{2} + \cos(x)^{2} = 1
\pi > 0
